scope: Local static matching of at-most-one-edge M11 escapes to even M12 proxies for all actual terminals. Direct even proxies and same-net even aliases allowed; other odd endpoints matched uniquely, with optional same-net post-match sharing. Every assigned M11 stub and M12 proxy independently owner/parity/bounds checked. Ignores all routed wires, congestion/history, native finite-wire feasibility and fullscene routing/timing; not a production plan or physical acceptance.
